paragraphs: Chapter 1128
Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (18)
Such a sentence was written on the recording window.
Jin blinked and reflexively reached for the blue window. As he did, he realized. That the only things moving on the battlefield right now were the blue shimmer of the recording window, and himself.
"Valeria, where are you? Explain it to me. What just happened? Did you stop time? Where am I supposed to move?"
No answer came.

However, for the first time in five days, Jin felt a sense of ease in his body and mind. His rotten left arm and all his other serious injuries hadn't healed, but at least the feeling of Kelliark's desire stabbing into his mind was fading.
Jin looked at the face of Valeria, whom he held in his arms. He remembered the fact that she had just died.
'The one showing the recording window now is the Valeria from another world... The one who stopped time must be her, too.'
This was not the time to grieve.
His brothers and comrades, the countless people who had thrown themselves to protect the world, and even the person he had loved since his past life had met their end.
He could not let it be in vain. Moreover, an ally with the power to trap even Kelliark in time had now appeared.
He suppressed all his surging emotions. So that he could focus on what was left to do.
'Where am I supposed to move?'
Looking around, he couldn't see any other recording windows. He could only see those who were on the verge of death, pierced by the hideous light Kelliark had dropped.
Jin looked at the window again and came to a conclusion.
'The path we were blindly taking was not wrong. Or, from the perspective of the other world's Valeria, the path is not important.'

Time. Suddenly, he thought of the time remaining until the curse on Temar's arm was lifted. He hadn't calculated it precisely while desperately breaking through Kelliark's sea, but there should be about thirty minutes left.
'First, I'll do what I can.'
He didn't know how long the other world's Valeria could keep time stopped.
'If my guess is right and Temar's left arm is more important than the path to the legacy, I need to check. To see if Lafrarosa's time has also completely stopped.'

The other world's Valeria had the ability to stop time while excluding specific individuals. If she could designate multiple people, then the two currently undoing the curse, Ameris and Lokia, should also be moving.
It was a question he could only answer by going to see for himself.
Before heading to the central battlefield, Jin first turned back and glared at Kelliark. Then he swung his sword towards his neck and heart. The sword energy accurately struck his neck and chest.
But there was no change. The sword energy stopped as soon as it touched Kelliark's body, then scattered and disappeared somewhere.
In other words, it was impossible to damage Kelliark in this state.

He hadn't had high expectations in the first place. Even if he could unilaterally tear Kelliark's body apart, the moment time resumed, he would instantly regenerate. After all, even with the Genesis Knights, the Sun God's egos, and the witch all joining in the attack, they hadn't been able to finish him off.
Next, Jin touched his comrades nearby. They too were completely still. Even when he pushed with force, there wasn't the slightest movement.
That was all he needed to check.

Without hesitation, Jin began to walk briskly towards Lafrarosa. He had to move quickly, not knowing when time might suddenly start flowing again. The feeling of leaving his father, brothers, and comrades behind was nauseating, but there was no other way.
"Father, Sister Vahn. If it weren't for you two, I wouldn't have even dared to try anything right now. Please take care of Enya and Orgal."
Jin glanced once at Enya, frozen in the same way she had been holding his hand, and Orgal, collapsed beside her, then began to walk.
The red sea, which had been churning so violently it was maddening to look at, was also frozen like a painting. When he stepped on it, it was as hard as steel.
He ran wildly. He leaped over waves that soared up to his head, and when a wave as huge as a fortress blocked his path, he went around it.

There was no chance of getting lost as he had when searching for the legacy's entrance. Far in the distance, in the central battlefield, the last light left by Lafrarosa, the golden fleet, and his comrades before time stopped was frozen sharply.
"Hoo, hoo."
He was out of breath.
He had only run a few hundred steps, but he was already out of breath up to his chin. He had only forgotten for a moment; Jin's body had been pushed to its limits all this time.
"Dammit, if I had known this would happen, I shouldn't have checked if I could hit that bastard. Right, Valeria?"

He himself didn't know which Valeria he was talking to. It felt like his mind would collapse if he didn't move while saying something like this. He had fought while suppressing his sorrow throughout the war, and he had resolved to move that way now too, but Jin was human.

Just because he was a Genesis Knight didn't mean he had a way to completely ignore the emotions that surged up. Tears would flow before he even recognized he was holding them back, and even when he gritted his teeth so hard his jaw trembled, a sob would sometimes escape his mouth.
That was why no matter how out of breath he was, he couldn't abandon the Valeria tied to his chest. Even if she was just a burden, he couldn't leave her behind.
"I can't accept this kind of ending. I can't accept that the reason I turned back time, the reason I did it, was for this kind of ending. Something... dammit!"
The whole time he was running across the crimson sea.
Jin felt like he was stepping on the cold bodies of his comrades somewhere below. Their faces, expressions, and gestures were vividly floating up right before his eyes.
Sometimes he would let out a gasp, cough up blood, stop for a moment to catch his breath, and then run again.
Thus, Jin was getting closer to the central battlefield. The comrades and enemies, frozen as they had been fighting, were coming into view one by one.
"Sister Luntia, Brother Daytona. Brother..."
Luntia, frozen with her thin sword, Charle, extended. Next to her stood Daytona, a magic beam just having pierced his chest.
Right behind them was a fallen Misa, and Mary, who was bending over to embrace him. Garmund was also seen, throwing his body to protect Mary, just like Linpa had.

Yona was screaming, holding the corpse of Owl, who had only one arm left, like a sword, while Tasha, Alpen, and Vallas were forming a sword formation. Among them, about half of Vallas's upper body was gone.
At their center, Luna was swinging Krantel towards the barrage the enemies were pouring down. The Battle Kings, including Baba, were supporting her, but there weren't many of them left.
The further he went, the more of his comrades' figures he saw.
"Murakan... you bastard, what are you doing collapsing at a time like this?"
Murakan had collapsed, transformed into a human. He spoke as if resentful, but he didn't mean it.

Jin felt sorry for him. The contractor he had met after enduring for a thousand years in the coffin in Storm Castle was just him, and he had ultimately collapsed, unable to escape the pain of the past.
"I'm sorry, Murakan."

The comrades from Tikan, unable to bring themselves to abandon Murakan, were struggling to hold their swords around him. If Sandra hadn't ordered Hedo to protect Murakan no matter what, he would have already been torn into dozens of pieces and disappeared.
Every time he passed them, his vision blurred. When he wiped his tears, black water spread on his fist and face.

At last, the area held by the members of Kinzelo appeared. They had already suffered near-annihilation. Two of the Demon Army's Genesis Knight mages were mangling Zephyrin's giant body, and among the members fighting under her protection, there was hardly anyone unharmed.
They, who had been enemies that had to be annihilated until just a short while ago, seemed to have been fighting while holding each other close, just like the Vamel Alliance.

Lanke, who had hated Ainas so much, had protected her in Bianca's place, and Berakt was gritting his teeth as he looked at the just-deceased Joe. Bubar was carrying the fallen Badrey on his back and rushing towards his comrades. Bishkel and Margiela were trying to escape the falling ship, Grenil.
"...Your leader is still alive. So endure, you bastards. Don't die."
Lafrarosa was getting closer.

Time was still stopped, and Jin suddenly felt a sense of anxiety. What if Ameris and Lokia were also frozen just like the others? What should he think then, where should he move? No other plan came to mind.
That's when he saw Dante, Veradin, and Syris.

They were forming the final defensive line right in front of Lafrarosa. Lucy's dragons were surveying the front lines, Eltiot was coordinating the lines based on that, and Dante was commanding the entire central front, screaming his lungs out.
Veradin had stopped while putting up a shield behind Syris, and Syris had stopped while barely getting up, supported by Myriad Ice.
Was it because they were his friends? Seeing them, Jin felt something hot spreading in his chest.
It must be strength. A strength that helped him shake off his anxiety, even for a moment, a strength that helped him face his vague hope, even for a moment.
"Everyone, please pray. That inside Lafrarosa, Ameris and that damn traitor Lokia are still moving."
Jin raised his head and looked up at Lafrarosa. His heart was pounding as if it would burst, and he had no strength left in his body. It seemed impossible to leap up in one go.
But fortunately, he had more magic left than that.

If he hadn't learned magic directly from Valeria since his past life, his magic too would have been completely depleted by now. There was no mage in the world who knew how to use magic more efficiently than her.
Soon, Jin slowly and carefully spread his magic and began to form a staircase leading to the sky. And after taking a deep breath, he climbed the stairs one step at a time.
"Hah, hah...!"
Now, even climbing the stairs was arduous. An increasingly harsh, metallic breath escaped him, but when he was about halfway up the stairs...
Jin could feel it. That inside Lafrarosa, a very busy flow of magic and chaotic energy was being formed.
It was the energy of Ameris and Lokia.
